_about: Copy for the Havas Play internship work. Read by scripts/import-havas.mjs (writes data/projects.json) and by app/work/havas-play/page.tsx and lib/projects.ts (intro, order, tiers). youtubeIds maps a manifest video number (n) to a YouTube id once the film is uploaded; the import then turns the pending placeholder into the YouTube facade. Slugs and order are fixed here; titles are display names. tier: "main" clients get a full card on the hub and in the homepage bracket row, "also" clients sit in the smaller "Also at Havas" section. A client or a piece that is not in data/havas-manifest.json is never imported, so removing it from the manifest is how it stays removed.

hub.title: Havas Play
hub.subtitle: Internship · Editor & Art Director · Paris · January to June 2026
hub.shortDescription: Internship at Havas Play, Paris: editing, art direction and some filming for sports and entertainment brands.
hub.intro: Havas Play is the sports and entertainment agency of Havas, based in Paris. Between January and June 2026, Remi worked there as an editor and art director, with some filming for a few clients: KFC, Renault, Sanofi, the Fédération Française de Judo, Kellogg's, Nissan, Allianz, Paris FC and Louis Burton, plus work made for the agency itself.
